title: MWE Public-Surface Dependency Inventory
description: Deterministic, identity-bearing record of every source file the public-surface authority-map builder or its companion validator reads, opens, hashes, or checks for existence in isolated candidate mode. Mechanical provenance only: it defines the read-dependency contract, not conceptual classification, relation, public/private, or Registry status, and it never records generator (executable transformation) identity. It contains only stable facts; volatile run evidence (timestamps, runtime, host, run IDs) is excluded by contract.

source_repository.description: Stable source repository identifier fixed by this contract.

interface_version.description: Version of the --source-root/--output/--inventory-output builder interface that produced this inventory.

dependency_count.description: Number of entries in files; must equal the length of files.

aggregate_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 over the deterministic concatenation of 'path:sha256\n' for every entry in files order.

files.description: Source dependency entries, sorted ascending by path, one per unique path.

path.description: Repository-relative forward-slash path under the source root. No absolute paths, no leading slash, no parent traversal, no backslashes.

byte_length.description: Exact byte length of the source file.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the source file bytes.

git_blob_sha1.description: Git blob object id (SHA-1 of 'blob <len>\0' + bytes) of the source file.

read_purposes.description: Sorted, unique set of read purposes actually observed for this path in candidate mode.
